Synopsis:
    Nepali mechanical foreman Sanjay Sah was rescued after nine days trapped in a tunnel following a catastrophic ice, rock and debris collapse that destroyed the Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Station and surrounding valley. He stayed behind to warn colleagues rather than flee. At least 900 workers are believed trapped across six hydropower projects along the Trishuli river. The wider disaster has killed at least 1,287 in Nepal, with over 5,000 missing. Two survivors have so far been extracted from the hydropower tunnels.
